designDetector.before: 9 anti-patterns after first restructure (4 cramped-padding, 1 clipped-overflow, 2 kicker-above-heading, 2 layout-transition)

intentionalChoices: First view is the instrument. The eyebrow-over-display-headline hero was the single most recognisable generated-UI shape on the page and it pushed the product below the fold.
Monospace for figures, Georgia for headings. Inter was dropped: the detector flags it as an overused face and Georgia was already carrying the distinctiveness.
Type floor of 12px, enforced by a four-step ramp rather than ad-hoc rem values. 70 nodes were below it before.
44x44 minimum on every control, including the allocation steppers, which were 28x28 - unusable money controls on a phone.
Motion is transform-based and state-bound. Width transitions were replaced because animating width thrashes layout.
The scenic raster is depth only and is deliberately faint; its ink/teal palette cannot lead without fighting the product's lime identity.
